msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. The model must be a completely different woman from anyone in the reference: a new face and a different hairstyle; never reproduce the face or likeness of a real person from the reference. If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. REGLA B: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia scarpa-02.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a burgundy patent leather trench coat with burgundy tights and burgundy heeled shoes from the reference, walking at the Bizkaia Bridge (Puente Colgante) over the river in Getxo and Portugalete, near Bilbao, Spain, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia scarpa-02.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a glossy burgundy patent leather trench coat with a belt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia scarpa-11.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): E-commerce product photo of a green and white striped trench coat with an orange silk scarf from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia scarpa-10.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a pink and brown check blazer with matching wide trousers and a cream top from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia scarpa-05.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a khaki cotton overshirt jacket with matching wide trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
